ValidationRule.description: Only Admin users can change a Status from Closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR($RecordType.Name = "NAS General Support Case", $RecordType.Name = "NAS Recurring Support Case"), ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "Closed"), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Closed Cases may not be Reopened. Please create a new Child Case or contact support.
